subject: Problem using system() inside a reactive expression

messages.author: 2dc50513792871a4
messages.subject: Problem using system() inside a reactive expression
parts:
Hi,

I did a search and came upon this previous thread:
https://groups.google.com/forum/?fromgroups=#!searchin/shiny-discuss/system/shiny-discuss/1PZ4_y6s6sk/rlqRwxqODvMJ

which tipped me off to the use of observe() for solving this problem. Unfortunately, in my case the problem remains. I have a reactive expression which is intended to use system() to run a shell script stored in the app folder after the user presses an action button. E.g.:

sysCall <- reactive({
x <- "Did not attempt to run system call"
if(input$goButton==0) return(x)
isolate(
observe({
system(paste0(getwd(), "/shell.txt ", getwd(), "/script.R"))
})
)
x <- paste("Attempted to run system call. wd:",getwd())
return(x)
})

I have tried all combinations here of isolate() and/or observe(), as well as hard-coding absolute paths even though pasting getwd() seems fine. I have also tried relative paths from the app directory, no luck. The system() call runs fine if I ssh into the shiny-server, go to the app directory, load an interactive R session and make the call at the console. The script.R launched by the shell.txt script sink()s a text file of its results to the app directory which I can then inspect. But when I run the app and press the action button, I print x to the main panel so I know it tried to run system(), but no results text file is generated. My hunch is that system() is still simply not executing. I get no errors of any kind. Is there anything else I can do to force system() to run?

Thanks,
Matt
